svg.title: Iysa Light Fighter - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 6, PDF 7. Single-deck exterior preserves long pointed nose, broad hooked crescent rear aerofoils with open forward recesses and small central aft power block. Bow left rotated up. Illustration corroborates claws around narrow body; fine barrel/vertical tail omitted. No internal missile racks or engines traced as hull.
